verdict.rationale: Adyen's Protect risk management system explicitly offers machine-learning fraud detection using global transaction data plus a rule builder to create, backtest, and label custom rules, matching the block/review/allow rule-writing need described in the story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence validating rule-builder usability or ML score accuracy, and no explicit mention of allow/block/review labeling terminology beyond 'rules'.
